project.name: uav-flight-mode-classifier
project.what_it_is: A flight-mode classifier for PX4 drones: reads 4 sensor values (vertical speed, horizontal speed, roll, pitch), outputs current flight mode + a ~1-2s-ahead forecast. LSTM trained on synthetic data, fine-tuned on 11 real PX4 logs. Also has a dependency-free C++ inference port for real-time/low-latency use.

known_unknowns_to_watch_for: Message field names/units: pymavlink's ATTITUDE (roll/pitch in radians) and LOCAL_POSITION_NED (vx/vy/vz in m/s, NED frame) must be converted to match flight_mode_inference.py's convention (roll_angle/pitch_angle in degrees from quaternion, vertical_speed = -vz, horizontal_speed = sqrt(vx^2+vy^2)) - verify src/live_inference.py's mavlink_source does this conversion correctly, it was written but never run against real data.
SITL's default MAVLink stream rates may need adjusting (PX4 param MAV_0_RATE or similar) if messages arrive too slowly for --min-interval to ever fire.

udp:127.0.0.1:14540 is PX4 SITL's default MAVSDK/offboard port - confirm it's actually emitting ATTITUDE and LOCAL_POSITION_NED on that port (may need SITL's mavlink instance/stream config checked if nothing arrives).
If pymavlink isn't installed: pip install pymavlink (it's already an optional line in requirements.txt).
